# Dolby Vision conformance excerpt

`dolby84-conformance.json` contains an actual HEVC Main 10 Dolby Vision Profile 8,
compatibility ID 4 bitstream with RPU NAL units, not an SDR file with a marker.

**Attribution:** *Sol Levante* by Netflix, Inc. Dolby, Inc. modified the work and
distributes its Dolby Vision rendition under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0.
Fresh Frame extracts approximately two seconds near 20 seconds by stream copy,
without re-encoding. Audio is omitted; narration audio is generated by the test.

- License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
- Legal text: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode
- Source and attribution document: https://github.com/DolbyLaboratories/dolby-vision-contents/tree/957c53ac160e11ae581aa1f4fe811a8ad6cf27df/SolLevante_Netflix
- Original: `BL_RPU_dvhe-08-84_1920x1080@24fps_0_6313.mp4`
- Upstream SHA-256: `d81d4c17958946796f30ca28a57776cee187a421649058767c8496cbc1e469bf`

The fixture JSON records the excerpt checksum. Reproduction with FFmpeg:

```sh
ffmpeg -i original.mp4 -map 0:v:0 -c copy -bsf:v hevc_mp4toannexb,extract_extradata -strict unofficial remux.mp4
ffmpeg -ss 20 -i remux.mp4 -t 2 -map 0:v:0 -c copy -strict unofficial -movflags +faststart excerpt.mp4
```

Parameter-set extraction makes the selected random-access segment independently
decodable. It preserves the actual video and Dolby RPU data. Confirm with
`ffprobe -show_streams -show_frames`; the stream must identify profile 8 / ID 4,
and decoded frames must contain Dolby Vision RPU side data. Native tests hash
this file before import and after repair/restore, then exercise Apple decoding,
SDR conversion, compositing and AAC narration. FFmpeg inspection does not
substitute for native tests or actual iPhone visual and audio approval.

No endorsement by Netflix or Dolby is implied. The excerpt is test-bundle-only
and is not included in the shipping application.
